info.title: Psikita Core API
info.description:
REST API for the Psikita mental-health platform.

**Audit trail:** all mutation endpoints (POST / PUT / PATCH / DELETE) are logged automatically by the global `AuditTrailInterceptor`.

**Validation:** invalid request bodies return `422 Unprocessable Entity` with per-field error details under the `messages` key.
